title: lasiorrhiza floribunda

The health benefits of Lasiorrhiza floribunda include its ability to treat various digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dysentery, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Lasiorrhiza floribunda include coumarins, flavonoids, and lignans, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
